note: The boundary between Villacana and the paseo/Barraka beach along the big-pool lawn: a white wall from the end of the sandstone wall to an arched gateway at the foot of Calle Guillermo, a short white wall, then white railings along the lawn to its east end. Turned-frame metres (sea downward); every line is 1.75 m inland of the paseo's centre line, just off the 3 m paving. Heights are metres above the paseo.
